rows.en: Module 6: Integrating MHPSS into programming across different areas of work
rows.ne: मोड्युल 6: विभिन्न कार्यक्षेत्रमा कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) एकीकृत गर्ने
rows.bt: Module 6: Integrating mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) into programme planning and implementation in various fields of work
rows.note: The clinical composite phrase is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T001 candidate. Proposals for module and integration are listed separately; review is pending.

rows.en: Module Learning Objectives
rows.ne: मोड्युलका सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरू
rows.bt: Learning objectives of the module
rows.note: Module is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Give examples of MHPSS activities integrated into programming across different sectors/clusters/AoRs
rows.ne: विभिन्न क्षेत्र/क्लस्टर/जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्रहरू (AoRs) मा कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा एकीकृत गरिएका MHPSS गतिविधिहरूका उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give examples of MHPSS activities integrated into programme planning and implementation in various sectors/clusters/areas of responsibility (AoRs).
rows.note: Integration and AoRs are absent from the supplied glossary; proposals are listed separately.

rows.en: Justify the importance of integrating MHPSS into humanitarian programming.
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्नुको महत्त्व तर्कसहित स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Explain with reasons the importance of integrating MHPSS into humanitarian programme planning and implementation.
rows.note: Integration is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Group Exercise - Part 1
rows.ne: सामूहिक अभ्यास - भाग 1
rows.bt: Group exercise - Part 1
rows.note: Group exercise is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: How can MHPSS be integrated into the sector you have been assigned?
rows.ne: तपाईंलाई तोकिएको क्षेत्रमा MHPSS कसरी एकीकृत गर्न सकिन्छ?
rows.bt: How can MHPSS be integrated into the sector assigned to you?
rows.note: Integration is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: (Use the MSP to help you.
rows.ne: (सहयोगका लागि MSP प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: (Use the MSP for help.
rows.note: The opening parenthesis continues into the next supplied row.

rows.en: Consider activities that can be led by the sector, and activities that can be supported by the sector.)
rows.ne: क्षेत्रले नेतृत्व गर्न सक्ने गतिविधि र क्षेत्रले सहयोग गर्न सक्ने गतिविधिबारे विचार गर्नुहोस्।)
rows.bt: Consider activities that the sector can lead and activities that the sector can support.)
rows.note: The closing parenthesis completes the preceding supplied row.

rows.en: What kind of MHPSS activities can be done by actors who are not MHPSS specialists (psychologists, psychiatrists)?
rows.ne: MHPSS विशेषज्ञ (मनोवैज्ञानिकहरू, मनोचिकित्सकहरू) नभएका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले कस्ता MHPSS गतिविधिहरू गर्न सक्छन्?
rows.bt: What kinds of MHPSS activities can involved parties who are not MHPSS specialists (psychologists, psychiatrists) carry out?
rows.note: The professional titles use frozen, unvalidated glossary candidates and remain examples of MHPSS specialists.

rows.en: (e.g. facilitators, legal advisors, teachers, nutrition staff, helpline staff, health workers, GBV officers, etc.)
rows.ne: (जस्तै, सहजीकरणकर्ता, कानुनी सल्लाहकार, शिक्षक, पोषणसम्बन्धी कर्मचारी, हेल्पलाइनका कर्मचारी, स्वास्थ्य कार्यकर्ता, GBV अधिकृत आदि)
rows.bt: (For example, facilitator, legal adviser, teacher, nutrition staff, helpline staff, health worker, GBV officer, etc.)
rows.note: The source list contains ordinary occupational descriptions and is translated rather than protected. GBV is retained unchanged.

rows.en: 20 min
rows.ne: 20 मिनेट
rows.bt: 20 minutes

rows.en: Group Exercise - Part 2
rows.ne: सामूहिक अभ्यास - भाग 2
rows.bt: Group exercise - Part 2
rows.note: Group exercise is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Review the ‘key consideration’ you have been given
rows.ne: तपाईंलाई दिइएको ‘मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष’ को समीक्षा गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Review the ‘key consideration’ given to you.

rows.en: Compare it to the ideas you discussed in Part 1.
rows.ne: यसलाई तपाईंले भाग 1 मा छलफल गरेका विचारहरूसँग तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Compare it with the ideas you discussed in Part 1.

rows.en: Add any additional activities that you may have missed to your flip chart.
rows.ne: छुटेका हुन सक्ने थप गतिविधि आफ्नो फ्लिप चार्टमा थप्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Add additional activities that may have been missed to your flip chart.
rows.note: Flip chart is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: 15 min
rows.ne: 15 मिनेट
rows.bt: 15 minutes

rows.en: Group Exercise - Part 3
rows.ne: सामूहिक अभ्यास - भाग 3
rows.bt: Group exercise - Part 3
rows.note: Group exercise is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Review the activities you have listed on your flip chart and discuss how well these have been implemented in your settings.
rows.ne: आफ्नो फ्लिप चार्टमा सूचीबद्ध गरेका गतिविधिको समीक्षा गर्नुहोस् र तपाईंले काम गर्ने सन्दर्भमा ती गतिविधि कत्तिको राम्ररी कार्यान्वयन भएका छन् भन्नेबारे छलफल गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Review the activities listed on your flip chart and discuss how well those activities have been implemented in the context in which you work.
rows.note: Flip chart is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Circle the ones that have been implemented.
rows.ne: कार्यान्वयन भएका गतिविधिलाई घेरा लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Circle the activities that have been implemented.

rows.en: 20 min
rows.ne: 20 मिनेट
rows.bt: 20 minutes

rows.en: MHPSS integration – Group discussion
rows.ne: MHPSS एकीकरण – सामूहिक छलफल
rows.bt: MHPSS integration – group discussion
rows.note: Integration is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Each group to present
rows.ne: प्रत्येक समूहले प्रस्तुति दिनुपर्छ।
rows.bt: Each group must give a presentation.

rows.en: Benefits of integrating MHPSS across sectors
rows.ne: विभिन्न क्षेत्रमा MHPSS एकीकृत गर्नुका लाभ
rows.bt: Benefits of integrating MHPSS into various sectors
rows.note: Integration is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately.

rows.en: Humanitarian emergencies = high need, not enough specialists
rows.ne: मानवीय आपत्कालीन अवस्था = आवश्यकता धेरै, विशेषज्ञ अपर्याप्त
rows.bt: Humanitarian emergency = many needs, insufficient specialists

rows.en: Integrating into wider systems (e.g. schools, health services, social care) & training non-specialists allows:
rows.ne: व्यापक प्रणालीहरूमा (जस्तै, विद्यालय, स्वास्थ्य सेवा, सामाजिक हेरचाह) एकीकृत गर्दा र गैरविशेषज्ञहरूलाई तालिम दिँदा निम्न कुरा सम्भव हुन्छन्:
rows.bt: Integrating into broader systems (for example, schools, health services, social care) and training non-specialists make the following possible:
rows.note: Integration is absent from the supplied glossary; a proposal is listed separately. Non-specialists is an ordinary role description, not newly coined clinical terminology.

rows.en: Reach more people
rows.ne: अझ धेरै व्यक्तिसम्म पुग्न सकिने
rows.bt: Able to reach more people

rows.en: More accessible
rows.ne: अझ बढी पहुँचयोग्य
rows.bt: More accessible

rows.en: Less stigma
rows.ne: कम कलङ्क
rows.bt: Less stigma
rows.note: Stigma is translated here as an ordinary social concept, not as a clinical diagnosis or instrument item.

rows.en: Often more sustainable
rows.ne: प्रायः अझ बढी दिगो
rows.bt: Often more sustainable

rows.en: Addressing MHPSS needs – better able to use other services, take care of themselves & others
rows.ne: MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकतालाई सम्बोधन गर्दा – अन्य सेवा प्रयोग गर्न तथा आफ्नो र अरूको हेरचाह गर्न अझ सक्षम हुने
rows.bt: When MHPSS-related needs are addressed – becoming more able to use other services and to care for oneself and others

rows.en: Wellbeing & other outcomes are mutually reinforcing
rows.ne: कल्याण र अन्य परिणामले एकअर्कालाई सुदृढ बनाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Well-being and other outcomes strengthen one another.
rows.note: Wellbeing is unqualified in the source and is not expanded to psychosocial well-being.

rows.en: e.g. nutrition & maternal distress, participation & decision making in shelter
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, पोषण र आमाहरूको व्यथा, आश्रयमा सहभागिता र निर्णय लिने प्रक्रिया
rows.bt: For example, nutrition and mothers' distress, participation in shelter and the decision-making process
rows.note: The fragment preserves the example pairings without equating maternal distress with stress or a diagnosis.
